prompt:
Task / size class:
Loop 112 — MEDIUM bounded SF-3 static Observed Signal display.

Goal:
Use the existing managed-block renderer and the accepted Jules/GitHub pure mappers to render ONE static Observed Signal section. Display facts only, separately from verified Runtime. Do not design a general status framework or write Issue #33.

Read first:
- docs/SIGNAL_FOUNDATION_ROADMAP.md (SF-2/SF-3 and separation rule)
- automation/command_bus/signal_observed_jules.py
- automation/command_bus/signal_observed_github.py
- automation/command_bus/loop_status_issue.py (replace_managed_block and existing Runtime/Development markers)
- automation/command_bus/loop_status_development.py and its test, as the existing local presentation pattern
- .github/workflows/loop-status-signal-test.yml
Inspect the existing code/tests before implementing anything.

Allowed changed paths ONLY:
1. automation/command_bus/signal_observed_render.py (new)
2. automation/command_bus/tests/test_signal_observed_render.py (new)
3. .github/workflows/loop-status-signal-test.yml (add only the above two paths to existing pull_request paths filter)

Hard scope / Do Not Touch:
No changes outside these paths. No network/GitHub/Jules/Issue calls, no live Issue #33 publication, no changes to Runtime/Development existing renderers, owner/receipt/evidence/registry/snapshot/schema, no CLI/DB/queue/webhook/provider abstraction/dependency. No unrelated workflow edits or extra tests. No Merge/rebase/force push/branch deletion/provider-model/API execution.

Existing implementation to reuse:
- map_jules_session_state_to_observed_signal in signal_observed_jules.py
- map_result_pr_head_to_observed_state and map_exact_head_github_run_to_observed_check in signal_observed_github.py
- replace_managed_block from loop_status_issue.py
- current DEVELOPMENT_START/END and RUNTIME_START/END managed-marker preservation pattern
Reuse these directly; do not duplicate mapping/validation tables or copy an entire status renderer.

Required semantics:
Implement a small pure render_observed_signal_section(snapshot) and render_observed_signal_body(existing_body, snapshot). Accept a simple dict with raw jules_session_state, result_pr_head, workflow_head_sha, workflow_status, workflow_conclusion. Reject non-dict snapshot with ValueError. Derive Jules/PR/exact-head-CI display values exclusively by calling the existing mappers. Render one bounded Observed Signal section, with separate Jules Session / result PR / exact-head CI facts, and an explicit sentence that this section does NOT prove durable runtime ownership, takeover, or overall success. Define distinct OBSERVED_START/OBSERVED_END managed markers locally in the new render module; use the existing replace_managed_block to append/replace only this section. Do not change existing verified Runtime or Development blocks. CI PASS means exact PR-head CI success only; SESSION_COMPLETE or PR_READY never automatically means overall PASS. Do not echo raw untrusted input strings into Markdown.

Negative / realistic failure cases:
- no result PR head (None) => NO_RESULT_PR and CI UNKNOWN, not FAIL or PASS;
- malformed PR head or mismatched workflow head => CI UNKNOWN, never PASS;
- unknown Jules state => UNKNOWN only for that fact;
- missing/partial/duplicate Observed block markers => use existing fail-closed marker behavior;
- successful exact-head CI still does NOT change Runtime block.

Acceptance criteria:
- IN_PROGRESS + None result head renders IN_PROGRESS / NO_RESULT_PR / UNKNOWN;
- COMPLETED + valid lowercase result SHA + matching workflow SHA + completed/success renders SESSION_COMPLETE / PR_READY / CI PASS as THREE separately labeled facts;
- stale workflow SHA, malformed result SHA, and unexpected Jules state map to UNKNOWN in the appropriate fact;
- append/replace is idempotent: exactly one Observed block; original Runtime and Development blocks are byte-for-byte preserved;
- no general schema, network access or issue mutation;
- final diff is a subset of exactly the three allowed paths;
- existing regression tests pass and only the two new file paths are added to the CI pull_request filter.

Exact validation commands:
python -m unittest automation.command_bus.tests.test_signal_observed_render -v
python -m unittest discover -v automation/command_bus/tests
python -m compileall -q automation/command_bus
git diff --check

Publication condition:
Create the normal isolated Jules result PR only if focused + full required suite, exact-path fence and semantic acceptance pass; include exact changed paths and test evidence. Never Merge. Existing separate Runtime/Development behavior must remain untouched.

Explicit stop conditions:
If existing markers/mappers cannot support this minimal read-only display without altering another file, stop with a concrete incompatibility. If any test or scope gate fails, do not publish success. retry=0; fallback=disabled.
